Overview

Banská Bystrica is a city in Banská Bystrica Region with a population of 76,018. A historic mining town in central Slovakia, the center of the Slovak National Uprising, surrounded by the Low Tatras mountains with excellent hiking and skiing. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
